card.name: Semi before -quantitative; praziquantel
card.fires_on: The word semi (or its hyphen) right before 'quantitative' in imaging-assessment text. Also the 'iqu' piece inside praziquantel, and 'qu' in a word like quip.

modes.label: Semi-quantitative
modes.description: The word 'semi' or the hyphen that comes just before 'quantitative' in PET imaging interpretation text.
modes.example: Do not rely solely on<< semi>>-quantitative values for interpretation.

modes.label: Inside praziquantel
modes.description: The 'iqu' piece in the drug name praziquantel, in interaction lists.

card.writes: It promotes endings like 'ant' and 'antic' and suppresses 'quant' words, so it favors completing the word with an 'ant' ending rather than 'quant'.
card.plain: It fires when the text is partway through words like semi-quantitative or praziquantel, just before the 'quant' part comes.
